Change the cleanup policy of a Docker repository

Change the cleanup policy; only the flags given change. The policy deletes the
tags that match --name-regex, except the --keep-last newest, those younger than
--keep-days and those matching --keep-regex, every --cadence (daily, weekly,
biweekly, monthly, quarterly).

This does not turn the policy on or off; rp docker cleanup enable does.

```
rp docker cleanup policy <repo> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --cadence string      How often the policy runs
      --keep-days int32     Keep tags younger than N days (7 to 90)
      --keep-last int32     Keep the newest N tags (1 to 100)
      --keep-regex string   Never delete the tags that match this regular expression
      --name-regex string   Delete only the tags that match this regular expression
```
